domain.text: software development: watcher PR Cost synchronization

impressions.text: The task was to reduce GitHub API writes by syncing displayed PR Cost text rather than raw USD changes.
The worker implemented the text-based marker and added a regression test covering sub-cent changes, cents changes, and null clearing; reported focused and full test suites passing.

The worker initially reported being blocked on the poll-level test; the orchestrator directed them to continue, and the worker identified that the attempted 1.265 fixture value still formatted as $1.26, resolving the test issue without fixture changes.
The orchestrator reported green CI and reviewed the implementation; the PR was merged.

roundCauses.text: The worker's initial block was due to difficulty triggering a subsequent cost write across watcher polls and the watcher lock lifecycle; the test-fixture issue was resolved by using a value that changes displayed cents.
